items.title: Enable the Worker scheduled() uptime sampler so the edge is measured, not merely reported unmeasured
items.why: Outcome: a /status/ reader finds a real edge-availability number. Since S349 the public status honestly says edge-unobservable, because every CI probe is bot-challenged. The sampler that can see the edge ships dark.
items.recipe: Create the production UPTIME_SAMPLES KV namespace, uncomment the binding and the 30-minute cron in cloudflare/wrangler.toml, flip UPTIME_SAMPLER_ENABLED to "1", and let the push-triggered Worker deploy run its promotion gate and release ceremony. Confirm with drain-uptime-kv --dry-run once a sample exists.

premises.claim: The sampler flag is committed dark.
The scheduled handler exists in the Worker.

evidence.interpretation: The gateway deploy token authenticates (wrangler whoami) but lacks KV scope (error 10000 on kv namespace list). The connected Cloudflare MCP on the same account (production-RATE_LIMIT id matches) can list and create namespaces, so this is agent work, not a founder action.
evidence.limitations: The CI deploy token must be able to bind the new namespace; it already binds RATE_LIMIT.

L2.recipe: Also drain samples into the history daily from CI.

L3.recipe: Multi-region samples through several cron vantages.

executionLog: S350: KV namespace creation denied by agent permission layer; gateway token lacks KV scope.

items.title: Root-fix the dead cleanup regex that leaves every superseded hashed shell tracked and servable
items.why: Outcome: stale CSS and JS stop being publicly servable and precache-reachable, and the repository stops growing by one shell per rotation. Eight stale shells are tracked today: six style.shell copies, one nav-sheet shell and one ambient-feature shell.
items.recipe: cleanupOldFingerprintedFiles built its pattern with a template literal ending `\${ext...}`. The backslash escaped the `$`, so the extension was never interpolated and the regex matched nothing. Escape both parts properly, then rerun build-shell-assets to prune.

premises.claim: The cleanup pattern escapes the interpolation.
A superseded style shell is still tracked.

evidence.interpretation: Reproduced in node: the compiled source is `^style.shell-[a-f0-9]{10}${ext.replace('.', '.')}$` and it returns false for style.shell-4b3ff55fa2.css. This replaces the S349 plan of writing a new manifest-diff prune: the prune already existed and had never worked.
evidence.limitations: Non-.cache references to stale hashes are archived performance traces, a fallback default in generate-pathways.mjs, and a comment in check-content-hotfix-gate.mjs. None loads the file.

L1.recipe: Fix the escape and rerun the build.

L2.recipe: Add a self-test asserting the pattern matches a synthetic stale name.

L3.recipe: Have the check mode fail on any unmanifested shell.

items.title: Stop hidden tabs from polling presence and rotating the Vault Pulse ticker; refresh the moment a reader returns
items.why: Outcome: a reader who comes back to the tab sees current presence and ticker rows immediately, and background tabs stop spending requests and battery on things nobody can see.
items.recipe: favicon-pulse tick returns early while document.hidden; vault-pulse skips rotation and pool refresh while hidden; all three scripts refresh once on visibilitychange to visible. desk-presence already skipped its network call while hidden, so it gains only the return-refresh.

premises.claim: favicon-pulse polls on a fixed interval without a visibility check.
vault-pulse refreshes its pool on a bare interval.

evidence.interpretation: S349 listed four uncancellable timers. Premise check: desk-presence refreshPresence already returns when !isReading(), and its 1s tick is deliberate idle accounting with no network. That half of the premise was false, which is a win recorded here.
evidence.limitations: favicon-pulse leader election stores the leader in sessionStorage, which is per tab, so every tab elects itself. Visibility gating removes most of the cost without redesigning election.

L2.recipe: Move leader election to localStorage with a heartbeat.

L3.recipe: One shared presence poller for all widgets.

items.title: Fix h1 to h3 heading skips on Community, Journal and Contact
items.why: Outcome: screen-reader and AI-agent outlines of these pages read as a proper hierarchy, so a user navigating by headings finds the Discord invite, the Dispatch signup and the contact channels.
items.recipe: Demote the skipping h3 elements to h2, and scope their existing per-page rules to h2 with font-family: inherit so the rendered look is unchanged.

premises.claim: Community's Discord heading is an h3 directly under the h1.
Contact's sidebar opens with an h3.

evidence.interpretation: The critical shell CSS sets h1,h2 to Georgia, so a plain demotion would change the font; inherit preserves it. assets/style.css has no global h2 rule.
evidence.limitations: Needs the rendered-pixel pass (CANON-053) on the three pages.

L3.recipe: Generate a heading outline into agents.json.

items.title: Recover the un-written-back S349 follow-up commit and close the CANON-055 gap on the record
items.why: Outcome: the session ledger and the surface follow-through check both tell the truth about 50f13941.
items.recipe: Record 50f13941 in the S350 write-back. Its user-facing effect is a CI probe's exit code and console line, not a site surface, so declare the CANON-055 exemption for it in LATEST_HANDOFF.

premises.claim: The write-back currency probe exists locally.

evidence.interpretation: check-writeback-currency: 1 substantive commit after the last SIL write, 20.7h old. check-surface-followthrough: gap, 11 files, none user-facing.

items.title: Contact form inputs collapse to 22px instead of 48px
items.why: Outcome: a visitor filling in the studio contact form gets full-height fields with readable placeholders, on the main inbound conversion path.
items.recipe: Scope flex:none to .contact-form .input-field so the column-flex .form-group stops overriding height.

evidence.interpretation: Found during the CANON-053 rendered-pixel pass. Measured with getBoundingClientRect: 22px desktop, 23px mobile, both themes.
evidence.limitations: Only contact/index.html nests .input-field inside .form-group, so the fix is page-scoped.

L2.recipe: Move the flex:1 onto the horizontal row selectors in style.css.

L3.recipe: Add a rendered-height assertion for form fields to the mobile audit.

executionLog: S350: found in the pixel pass and shipped.
